# Proverbs 11 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 11:1 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Scales-of deceit [are an]-abomination-of YHWH, but-a-weight complete [is] His-delight. |
| LOGOS | A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, but a just weight is His delight. |
| PNEUMA | The LORD despises dishonest scales, but accurate weights make Him glad. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
